scope.purpose: Show that something is loading when the duration is unknown and the place is small.
useCases: In an empty panel while its content loads.
The loading state of a control (Button and IconButton draw the same ring today).
exclusions: Color options: the spinner inherits the current content color.
alternatives: Skeleton for the first load of a region.

examples.preview: dist/previews/spinner.html (npm run build && npm run build:preview spinner)

decisionsTaken: Same drawing as the Button loading indicator (ring r 9 in a 24 box, stroke 2.5, quarter arc), so that a later Modify can make Button and IconButton use the Spinner without a visual change.
Sizes sm, md, lg, xl on size.icon.* (16, 20, 24, 32 px).
Color inherited (currentColor); track at the component token component.spinner.track-opacity (0.2; Button uses 0.25 hard-coded).
label empty by default: decorative; a non-empty label makes it a polite status.

One turn per component.spinner.duration (component token, primitive 700 ms; Button hard-codes 800 ms), three times slower under reduced motion (the Button rule). Spinner values are component tokens: Button and IconButton will compose the Spinner rather than share the tokens.

Open question 5 accepted for the implementation review (user, 2026-11-03: "Ok, à juger dans l'implémentation"): component.spinner.duration = 700 ms; the speed is judged on the real rendering at the implementation gate, and Button and IconButton adopt the Spinner after the wave.
nextAction: Documentation (ggb-docs), then the pull request of wave 3 to main.
implementationNotes: A labelled spinner is a role status named by aria-label (a status takes no name from its content in Chromium) with the same text visually hidden inside it as the announced content. Whether a status inserted already filled is announced varies between screen readers: the application may keep a status region on the page and fill it instead.
